verses.raw: So whoever Allāh wants to guide - He expands his breast to [contain] Islām; and whoever He wants to send astray<sup foot_note=254347>1</sup> - He makes his breast tight and constricted as though he were climbing into the sky. Thus does Allāh place defilement upon those who do not believe.
